blocks.content: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet is responsible for making appointments to several top-level posts in the Government of India.

items: Exam Question Focus: Always remember that the ACC is chaired by the Prime Minister, not the Home Minister or President.
Key Distinction: Appointments of the RBI Governor, Chairman of UPSC, and Chiefs of the Armed Forces require ACC approval or recommendation.
Administrative Secretariat: The Establishment Officer in the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) acts as the Secretary to the ACC.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) is chaired by the Prime Minister of India.
The Union Minister of Home Affairs is a permanent member of this committee.
The ACC decides top-level appointments in the Central Secretariat, Public Sector Undertakings, Financial Institutions, and the Armed Forces.
The Establishment Officer functions as the Secretary to the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.
